_comment: Fictional synthetic articles for Story Intelligence tests: two multi-article storylines (an AI math model from launch to evaluation, adoption and correction; a semiconductor capacity announcement vs. reported output) plus unrelated noise. 'days_ago' is relative to the test's clock. 'duplicate_of' marks a syndicated copy.

articles.title: Nimbus Labs launches Atlas-3, a math tutoring model for high school students
articles.summary: Nimbus Labs released Atlas-3 on Tuesday and said the model scores 92% on its own MathBench algebra benchmark. The company said Atlas-3 explains each step of a solution and will be offered to high schools this fall.

articles.title: Nimbus Labs debuts Atlas-3 math model and claims a top MathBench score
articles.summary: Startup Nimbus Labs unveiled Atlas-3, an AI model aimed at high school mathematics, and claimed a 92% score on the MathBench algebra benchmark. No outside evaluation of the Atlas-3 model was available at launch.

articles.title: An independent evaluation of the Atlas-3 math model on unseen high school algebra problems
articles.summary: Researchers at the Open Evaluation Institute evaluated Atlas-3 on 1,200 unseen algebra problems and found it solved 71%, below the 92% Nimbus Labs reported. The authors note the problems differ from MathBench and that the preprint has not been peer reviewed.

articles.title: Independent benchmark finds Atlas-3 math scores lower than Nimbus Labs claimed
articles.summary: An evaluation by the Open Evaluation Institute found the Atlas-3 model solved 71% of unseen algebra problems, compared with the 92% Nimbus Labs reported on its own MathBench test. Nimbus Labs disputes the methodology, saying the problem set was harder than typical high school coursework.

articles.title: Opinion: The Atlas-3 math model is a breakthrough for high school algebra
articles.summary: Atlas-3 could transform how high school students learn algebra, argues a former math teacher, who says the Nimbus Labs model's step-by-step explanations matter more than benchmark scores.

articles.title: Riverside Unified School District adopts Atlas-3 math model for algebra classes
articles.summary: Riverside Unified School District will pilot the Atlas-3 math model from Nimbus Labs in 14 high schools this semester, district officials said, citing the model's step-by-step algebra explanations.

articles.title: Correction: Open Evaluation Institute revises Atlas-3 algebra score
articles.summary: An earlier version of this article said the Atlas-3 math model solved 71% of algebra problems in the Open Evaluation Institute evaluation. The institute's corrected figure is 74%, still below the 92% Nimbus Labs reported.

articles.title: Independent benchmark finds Atlas-3 math scores lower than Nimbus Labs claimed
articles.summary: An evaluation by the Open Evaluation Institute found the Atlas-3 model solved 71% of unseen algebra problems, compared with the 92% Nimbus Labs reported on its own MathBench test. Nimbus Labs disputes the methodology.

articles.title: Kestrel Semiconductor announces new chip fab capacity in Arizona
articles.summary: Kestrel Semiconductor said it plans to add 20,000 wafers per month of 3-nanometer chip capacity at its Arizona fab by 2027, citing demand for AI accelerators.

articles.title: Kestrel Semiconductor's Arizona fab expansion could lift orders for chip packaging suppliers
articles.summary: Analysts said Kestrel Semiconductor's planned Arizona fab capacity of 20,000 wafers per month may lift orders for packaging suppliers such as Corvid Materials, though the timeline depends on equipment deliveries.

articles.title: Kestrel Semiconductor Arizona fab output falls short of its capacity projections
articles.summary: Kestrel Semiconductor said its Arizona fab produced 12,000 wafers per month in the third quarter, short of the 20,000 wafers it projected, citing equipment delays.

articles.title: Kestrel Semiconductor 8-K: update on Arizona fab capacity ramp
articles.summary: Kestrel Semiconductor disclosed in an 8-K filing that the ramp of its Arizona fab to 20,000 wafers per month is delayed by two quarters because of equipment delivery delays.

articles.title: Fed holds interest rates steady and signals patience on cuts
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate unchanged at its meeting and said it would watch inflation data before cutting rates.

articles.title: State expands free school meals program to 300 more districts
articles.summary: The state education board approved money to extend free breakfast and lunch to 300 more districts next year, officials said.

articles.title: Brightpath Robotics raises $40 million Series B for warehouse robots
articles.summary: Brightpath Robotics raised $40 million in a Series B round led by Harbor Point Ventures to expand production of its warehouse picking robots.

articles.title: CISA warns of actively exploited flaw in popular VPN appliances
articles.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a VPN vulnerability to its catalog of known exploited flaws and urged federal agencies to patch.
